name: Shisō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shisō city emblem in green and yellow: a green ring open at the top enclosing a yellow stylised figure.
history: Municipal flag of Shisō, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Shisō city emblem — a green ring open at the top enclosing a yellow stylised figure
